name: Ambiq HAL v4.3.0-ambiq.v1.0.0
body:
This release of the Ambiq HAL accompanies Zephyr distribution **v4.3.0-ambiq.v1.0.0**.

It adds HAL support for two new parts, **Apollo330P** and **Apollo510L**, both taken from AmbiqSuite SDK 5.2.0, and adds **Apollo2** HAL support from AmbiqSuite SDK 2.5.1.

## What changed

Beyond the new parts, the substantive work is in three areas:

- **CryptoCell 312 cryptography** — extended across Apollo510, Apollo510L and Apollo330P with ChaCha20, SHA, PKA, ECC, ECDSA and AES.
- **Radio FW Bluetooth** — a bundled controller firmware image, an automatic firmware check-and-update flow, and recovery from a corrupt or interrupted NVM update.
- **Graphics** — the Nema SDK was split into NemaGFX and NemaDC and refactored to sit on the Zephyr GPU driver.

Also in this release: I2S full-duplex support and a `TX_FIFO_EMPTY` interrupt, an Apollo4x IOM fix for the intermittent I2C hang, IOS I2C support on Apollo3x, and unified AMOTA application OTA packaging tools.

## Zephyr integration

This HAL is pinned by `west.yml` in Zephyr distribution v4.3.0-ambiq.v1.0.0 as project `ambiqhal_ambiq`.
